_comment: Chat accounts (docs/chat.md): the agent reads and posts in Microsoft Teams within what this section allows. Merge the Orkeon section into config/appsettings.local.json and keep the accounts you use. 'me' signs in as you (orkeon chat login me, once, in a terminal); 'watch' is an application that only reads, its certificate named by a variable; 'builds' posts into one place through a Workflows webhook whose address is in a variable. Replace the ids with those of your Microsoft Entra application and tenant. No secret goes in this file: a variable is named, never valued. An empty AllowedPlaces allows nowhere.
